name: a match of rounds
describe: A match of several short rounds with the rounds won counted: best of N or first to N; everything goes back to a round's start between two.
pick: short rounds whose wins add up to the match

rounds.description: The most rounds a match has (best of this many)

winsToWin.description: Rounds a player must win to take the match (0: more than half of rounds)

between.description: Seconds between two rounds, while every screen says who took the last one

textTook.description: Banner when a round is won ({name}, {n})

textNobody.description: Banner when nobody took a round ({n})

hooks.name: roundStart
hooks.when: each round of the match starts (scores, p.data and the mechanics are back at a round's start)

hooks.name: check
hooks.when: ten times a second: is this round over before its clock? The match counts the win

hooks.name: results
hooks.when: the match is over: p.score is now the rounds each player won

notes: Write one short round as for a timed round; the kit plays it again, counts who took each one (ctx.match.wins(p)) and ends the match at round.params.winsToWin or after round.params.rounds.
Everything a round sets up goes in roundStart(ctx): it runs at the start of every round of the match, after scores, p.data and ctx.shared are back at their start.
promise: Rounds are won one at a time, the match ends when someone has enough, and it plays again.
